claim_ceiling: Dense embeddings characterized as complementary modes (citation heritage, cross-lingual, linear hybrid) at 22yr/144k evaluated scale, extended to 24yr/158k for citation heritage. No representation achieves factory jurist preference target (0.7) under true OOS conditions. TF-IDF citation hybrids remain primary product mode at 174k.
evidence_summary: All 17 evidence_refs verified. Citation heritage AUCs reproduced from raw data: center_projected_64dim AUC 0.7922 (22yr, 344 pairs), 0.7667 (24yr, 730 pairs) > 0.75 threshold. Section cross-lingual metrics reproduced: Sachverhalt cp_64 cross_lang_same_branch=0.282 > 0.2 PASS, Dispositiv=0.150 > 0.1 PASS, Erwaegungen=0.094 < 0.1 FAIL. Weight sweep optima reproduced: cited_decisions_tfidf w=0.4 JP=0.6725 PASS, outcome_hybrid_0.5 w=0.3 JP=0.6115 PASS; both below TF-IDF baseline JP=0.784-0.789. Two-mode tradeoff confirmed across 4 scales (15yr, 19yr, 22yr, 174k): TF-IDF LangDom~0.48/JP~0.78, Dense LangDom~0.83-0.98/JP~0.05-0.43, Hybrids intermediate. v8 holdout leakage minimal (-0.015 to -0.020). True OOS JuristPref ceiling ~0.53 < 0.7. Legal TF-IDF bge_ corpus negative: 6-8/14 PASS, ALL FAIL citation heritage (AUC~0.5). v18 coarse hierarchy negative: best purity 0.65 < 0.7. Scale characterization (12k): dense cross-lingual degrades in representativeness at scale; legal area purity drops 0.61->0.47. Data blockers accurately diagnosed: bge_/bger_ ID mapping, parquet 2024-2026 (15,536 decisions), section extraction at 174k; 2022-2023 embeddings exist and PASS citation heritage but flagged failed in progress.json. No defects requiring repair; negative results honestly represented as evidence.
